fit.gap_handling_summary: The application presents the candidate's strongest real fit: production NLP, Azure serving, monitoring, annotation quality and complaint classification. It carefully labels RAG as a personal, manually checked prototype and does not invent LLM fine-tuning, CI/CD, Kubernetes or additional cloud experience. As of November 2026, the explicitly documented production ML-engineer role spans approximately three years and eight months; the earlier data-science role is not shown to involve production shipping. End-to-end pipeline ownership, data versioning, automated tests, cost evaluation and cross-team integration remain unproven.

issues: The education section is split across pages, leaving the MSc entry alone at the top of page two.
The five-plus-year summary is supported as broad experience, but should not be interpreted as five-plus years shipping production ML systems.
Several first-role bullets are long and technically dense, reducing scan speed.

reasons: The single-column PDF extracts in a sensible order, including contact details, dates and technical skills.
Strong coverage of Python, Azure, MLflow, production serving, monitoring and NLP; customer-service reporting is a semantic match for customer support.
Evaluation is evidenced through accuracy, macro F1 and manual prototype checks, although the exact phrase 'model evaluation' is absent.
TF-IDF demonstrates feature engineering, but that explicit keyword is missing.
The four-year production-engineering threshold and production RAG experience could trigger stricter screening.
CI/CD, automated tests, data versioning and explicit pipeline ownership are not evidenced.

issues: Much of the middle section repeats the CV's metrics and technology list rather than developing one concise example of engineering decisions or collaboration.
The closing could make the transfer from complaint classification to merchant-support workflows more concrete without implying prior ticket-routing experience.
The opening broad experience statement does not establish the required four years of production ML engineering.
strengths: Names the correct company and exact role.
Connects complaint classification and production NLP to merchant-support automation.
Uses concrete, supported throughput, quality and monitoring outcomes.
Clearly distinguishes the weekend RAG prototype from production work.
Uses the company's documented ownership, teamwork and learning values without inventing culture.
Avoids the earlier letter's obsolete bank-current-employer framing and local-work preference.

statements_in_outputs: Data Scientist, Baranjska kreditna banka d.d., Zagreb (remote from Osijek)

spacing_issues: The CV's education section begins at the foot of page one, while the MSc entry is isolated at the top of page two.
CV page one is dense, whereas page two is only 45.5% filled; rebalancing the page break would improve the document.
The RAG project heading wraps its year onto a separate line.
consistency_issues: The CV uses blue rules, bold section headings and coloured links, while the letter is unaccented; the shared serif typography nevertheless makes them reasonably coherent.
issues: Some experience bullets occupy three or four lines and require sustained reading.
The research-assistant employer/title line is crowded against its right-aligned dates, although it remains readable and does not overlap.

fluency_and_tone_issues: 'Mentor two students on professional internships' is understandable but less idiomatic than 'Mentor two student interns.'
'production-quality monitoring' in the letter is slightly ambiguous; 'production model-quality monitoring' would state the intended meaning more clearly.
'monitoring helped identify the issue and support remediation' is abstract; 'monitoring identified the issue, which was resolved within a week' would be more direct.

notes_facts_used: PhD remains in progress, with expected completion in 2027; no doctoral title is claimed.
Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, obtained in 2024.
Guest lecture at an NLP summer school in 2025, lasting 90 minutes.
RAG/LLM experience is limited to a weekend prototype, not production work.
The documents respect the Azure-only and no-Kubernetes boundaries.
The application stays focused on NLP/document AI rather than computer vision.
notes_facts_ignored: Daily English-language client meetings with a Slovenian client are not used.

parsed.summary: Both documents are well grounded, technically specific and appropriately tailored to Quillstone's customer-support AI role. They preserve the unfinished PhD status and honestly distinguish personal RAG experimentation from production experience. The candidate's production NLP, Azure deployment and monitoring credentials are strong, but four years of production ML engineering, production assistants, data versioning and CI/CD are not established. The PDFs are readable and ATS-friendly, with the main presentation weakness being the split education section and uneven CV page density.
